description: A test file for the PendingMessagesComponent, verifying rendering of messages and clearing functionality.

classes.name: PendingMessagesComponent
classes.description: A UI component that manages and renders pending messages related to steering and follow-up modes.

methods.name: setMessages
methods.description: Sets the list of messages to be displayed by the component.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns the rendered output of the component as an array of strings based on the current messages and a given height.

methods.name: clearMessages
methods.description: Clears all pending messages from the component.
